title: Reading the installation prompt

question: What is the purpose of the install prompt?

explanation: Show installation guidance only when the browser reports eligibility or a platform-specific path exists. explanation: A cache update message is a notification that informs users of changes to data or app files. As the number of data files increases, users need to be able to track the update process.
